fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: Watch offer, the learner says yes: two focus entries (Door first, then Needle), Needle's place in one sentence, A and Shift+P asked first, the demo only on Needle

checks.detail: turn 3: "Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge"

rubric.reason: After the learner's "Yes, please show me on Needle first" (Turn 3), the mentor set focus to Door then Needle. It said Needle's place in one sentence ("Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge") and asked for A then Shift+P before moving anything. In Turn 4 it demonstrated only on anchor/15 (Needle) and left Door to the learner.

In Turn 4 the mentor took a frame at time 0, moved only Needle's pivot, and took a second frame at time 0. It said "Both numbers changed, and Needle didn't move. The frame from before and the frame from after look the same, and that's the point," and added that Edit > Undo reverses it, with no values read out and no claim about how the numbers changed.

Turn 4 reports one change in plain words with real names ("I've moved Needle's pivot to the middle of its bottom edge") and says Edit > Undo reverses it. It then hands Door to the learner ("Now Door is yours... Set it yourself") without offering to do it, and uses no undo label or field names.

Every name the mentor used appears in tool results: Door and Needle, their places (middle-left, bottom-middle), Door's pivot at center (place_now), and Anchor Point and Position. "Needle didn't move" follows from the identical layer_bounds before and after the demo.

checks.detail: turn 3: "Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge"

rubric.reason: Turn 3 sets two focus entries (Door first, Needle second), says Needle's place in one sentence ("Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge"), and asks for A then Shift+P before anything moves; in Turn 4 anchor_demo runs on anchor/15 (Needle) only, and Door is handed to the learner.

The mentor asked for Needle selected with A then Shift+P, took a frame at 0, ran one anchor_demo on Needle, and took a second frame at 0; it then said "Both numbers changed, and Needle didn't move" plus Edit > Undo, read out no values, and added no claim about how the numbers changed.

Turn 4 describes one change in plain words with real names ("Needle's pivot is now in the middle of its bottom edge"), gives Edit > Undo with no undo label or field names, and hands Door to the learner ("Now it's your turn, on Door") without offering to do it.

Door, Needle, Anchor Point, Position, Door's current center pivot and both places (middle-left, bottom-middle) all match the anchor_snapshot and anchor_demo results; no time or invented layer is mentioned.
